note: Private RV park two blocks south of I-90 Exit 325 on the edge of Mitchell. Shaded pull-through and back-in sites on about 11 acres, three 20-amp tent sites that also take a small motorhome, and five cabins (2-night minimum); large outdoor pool and playground. Weekly and seasonal stays are also sold. --Claude
